comments.text: 20k fits the market data: Inmuebles24's mid-2026 index puts a typical 2-bed asking rent in CDMX around MX$21,900, while crowdsourced 1-beds outside the centre average about MX$12,200. And watch the CFE bill in a place with AC: once your yearly average goes over 250 kWh/month you're moved to DAC, and 251 kWh costs about MX$2,128 vs MX$720 at 250.
